messages:
Carmen L: Quick heads-up — I submitted my resignation. Last day will be Apr 9. Can someone confirm the checklist for hardware return, benefits/COBRA, payroll, and the exit interview? cc @Ben @Tara M
Ben: Congrats on the new role, Carmen! We'll get you sorted. Paging @peopleops-bot, @IT Support, and @Payroll to confirm timelines.
peopleops-bot: Checklist created: [hardware-return, keycard, data-handoff, exit-interview, benefits-notice, final-paycheck]. Link: https://intra.redwood/peopleops/checklists/1965432100
Tara M: Carmen — benefits notes: active coverage ends at 11:59pm on your last day (Apr 9). COBRA packet will be triggered within 5 business days of termination and you have a 60-day election window from the packet date. I can DM you the packet preview.
Felix R: For IT/hardware: we do a remote wipe 72h after last day unless device is returned earlier. We can send a prepaid return label or you can drop off at HQ. If you have private files to keep, back them up to personal cloud before returning.
IT Support: Options: 1) Ship label + box (we cover). 2) Office dropoff at security desk. Please request a label by EOD Apr 6 if shipping. We'll also schedule Okta/Slack deprovision at 17:00 PT on Apr 9 unless a grace access ticket is opened.
Payroll: Final paycheck will include salary through Apr 9. PTO payout follows state rules — confirm your state in your profile. Please submit any outstanding expense reports and final timesheet by Apr 7 to avoid delays.
Carmen L: Thanks all. Can we book the exit interview for the last week? Prefer Tue afternoon if possible. Also do I need to physically return my keycard?
Ben: We aim to do exit interviews in the final week. @peopleops-bot add a 30m exit interview in the checklist and propose Tue Apr 7 3pm PT. If that doesn't work, we can do a short phone interview on your last day.
peopleops-bot: Added: exit interview (30m) scheduled tentative for Apr 7 15:00 PT. Added benefits wrap (15m). Reminder: update HRIS after COBRA election.
Tara M: COBRA specifics — coverage is retroactive to the day after termination. Once you elect, coverage will be continuous back to Apr 10. Deadline to elect is 60 days from the packet; packet sent within 5 business days unless we need additional paperwork.
Felix R: Access removal summary: Admin console, cloud infra, and code repos deprovisioned 18:00 PT on Apr 9. If you need a brief overlap for handoff, fill out a grace-access ticket and we'll restrict it to the necessary systems.
Carmen L: I'll upload handoff docs and a list of active tickets by Mon Apr 6. Also will confirm whether I want COBRA — please DM details.
IT Support: Keycard: yes please return. We have an office dropbox or we can mail a return label. Card will be disabled same day of termination.
Ben: :thumbsup: Summary for Carmen — action items for you: 1) Submit timesheet/expenses by Apr 7, 2) Upload handoff notes by Apr 6, 3) Choose COBRA or waiver after packet, 4) Ship/return laptop/keycard or drop off, 5) Attend exit interview.
peopleops-bot: Closing checklist note: When COBRA election received, update benefits_status in HRIS -> https://benefits.example/COBRA-instructions. If any delays, reply here or open a ticket at #help-peopleops.
